summary: F1: exact vector search is now the default everywhere. MemoryRAG, Settings and MemoryService default to ann_enabled=False and ann_exact_threshold=5000. COGNIMEM_ANN_EXACT_THRESHOLD < 1 is rejected when config loads; before, a value of 0 silently made the module-level `app` None. The CLI gets a global `--ann` flag. Vector-index objects are cached per (approximate, embedder.model_id), so store.list() is never called when ANN is off. VectorIndex scoring is now one float64 numpy matmul. It keeps the old (-score, chunk_id) order exactly: all 497 real-BGE LoCoMo questions and all 988 end-to-end top-10 lists are identical to the old code. ApproximateVectorIndex builds its buckets with numpy. It probes radius 0, then 1, then 2; within a radius it tries the buckets nearest the query's hyperplanes first, and it keeps going until it has max(limit, min_candidates=400) allowed candidates. Otherwise it falls back to exact search. It records `last_search` diagnostics, which also appear in each hit as `vector_index`. The LSH fingerprint now covers version, tables, bits, seed and dimension. F2: the default pool is min(200, max(100, 4*limit)), which also fixes the crash for limits 51-100. MemoryRAG(candidate_pool=None) is wired to COGNIMEM_CANDIDATE_POOL. model_threads is wired to COGNIMEM_MODEL_THREADS, and the reranker default is threads=None. Reranker inputs are capped at 600 characters at a word boundary; the returned snippets stay full length. Results on the first 3 LoCoMo conversations, hybrid_reranked: Recall@5 rises from 56.1% to 66.9% and pool hit from 69.0% to 90.7% at the new default pool of 100. Median (P50) latency rises from 97 ms to 625-690 ms on a loaded machine. Forced ANN gives Recall@5 54.1% at pool 20 (old ANN: 28.3%) and 66.5% at the default pool. On the fresh-benchmark dev split the change is neutral. A one-time held-out test run gives hybrid_full Recall@5 93.7% (baseline 93.0%). LSH still loses a lot of recall on real conversational vectors at 5k+ chunks, even with the guard, so ANN should stay off. Full patch: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-josephremingstonl-Downloads-code-capstone/2d91e859-4acd-4fbf-99c1-146f2e2aa197/scratchpad/design/annpool/out/full.diff (dry-run applies cleanly to the current repo files).
root_cause: F1: ANN was on by default once a store had 256 or more memories. The old multi-probe stopped as soon as any radius-0 bucket matched, typically about 16-50 of 2,000 chunks. There was no minimum candidate count and no exact fallback, so most true neighbours were never scored. On real LoCoMo BGE vectors the old LSH top-20 agreed with exact search only 26.8% of the time. The corpus count for the threshold came from store.list() over every user, on every `vectors` access, and a new index object (with LSH hyperplanes rebuilt in Python) was created each time. _fingerprint hashed only the chunk rows, so changing the LSH parameters never rebuilt the buckets. Config accepted threshold 0, which MemoryRAG then rejected inside create_app; the module-level try/except turned that into app=None. F2: a pool of max(20, 4*limit) gives the cross-encoder too few candidates on long conversations; gold evidence reached the reranker in only 69.0% of LoCoMo questions on the 3-conversation subset. 4*limit is also above the 200 cap for limits 51-100, which raised ValueError, including through the API (limit le=100). The reranker was pinned to 2 threads, and reranker inputs were up to 1,000-character chunks.

proposed_changes.description: VectorIndex: _validate, a numpy _rank (float64 matmul with the same (-score, chunk_id) order), search_vector(vector) so callers can reuse an embedded query, and last_search diagnostics. ApproximateVectorIndex: min_candidates=400; numpy _signatures (planes stored as a (tables*bits, dim) array); a VERSION/tables/bits/seed/dim header in _fingerprint; radius-major, query-directed _probes (radius 0, then 1, then 2; within a radius, the buckets with the smallest summed |projection| first), probed in geometrically growing batches with a row-value IN query until max(limit, min_candidates) allowed chunks are found. When the allowed set is no larger than the target it goes straight to exact search; when radius 2 is exhausted it falls back to exact search. last_search is recorded for every path.

risks:
1) Latency. Pool 100 multiplies reranker work. LoCoMo P50 went from 97 ms to 625-690 ms and benchmark P50 from 85 ms to 465 ms on a loaded machine. threads=None (-23%) and the 600-character cap (-41% on long documents) only partly offset this. Pool 50 keeps most of the gain (LoCoMo Recall@5 .650 vs .669, P50 325 ms) and is the setting to suggest for latency-sensitive deployments (COGNIMEM_CANDIDATE_POOL=50).
2) Fusion-only paths. The larger default pool also lengthens each channel list before RRF, so hybrid search with rerank=False changes order: dev vector_graph top-1 .639 → .518, LoCoMo hybrid_fusion Recall@5 .482 → .468. Single-channel modes are unaffected. This was visible on dev before the held-out run. Suggested follow-up, not in the patch and not measured: use max(20, 4*limit) capped at 200 when should_rerank is False, and default_pool() only when reranking.
3) ANN quality. The synthetic guard passes, but real BGE conversational vectors at 5,882 memories keep only 41-62% top-20 agreement with exact even when 15-28% of the corpus is scanned. ANN should stay off and be documented as experimental. A better future option is exact search over a cached in-memory float32 matrix (most of the 28 ms is SQLite blob reads) or HNSW, not further LSH tuning. The VERSION=2 fingerprint forces a one-time bucket rebuild for anyone who already has ANN on.
4) Behaviour changes:
- The ANN threshold is now compared with the requesting user's corpus (search and sync) rather than store.list() across all users. The `vectors` property keeps the old whole-store count for compatibility.
- options_from_env is stricter: unknown COGNIMEM_ANN_ENABLED strings now raise instead of silently meaning false.
- COGNIMEM_MODEL_THREADS applies to both the embedder and the reranker. The FastEmbedder default of 2 threads is unchanged when the variable is unset.
- Hits gain a `vector_index` key.
- On a busier or smaller machine, threads=None may oversubscribe the CPU; COGNIMEM_MODEL_THREADS can pin it.
5) Harness. Protocol.ann_exact_threshold=1 means `--ann` forces LSH on the small benchmark corpora. That keeps the ANN arm meaningful, and the old 256 threshold was already below every corpus size, so results stay comparable with the old ANN reports.
6) Reranker cap. The cross-encoder now judges only the first ~600 characters of a 1,000-character chunk, so evidence near the end of a long chunk can be scored lower. Snippets and context still use the full chunk.
7) Fixed costs. The LSH probe list is built in Python (448 probes per query) and rows are kept as sqlite3.Row objects; fine at the measured sizes.
